sloka: स तदा ह्रियमाणो ऽपि कुम्भकर्णात्मजेन ह।आजघानानिलसुतो वज्रकल्पेन मुष्टिना ।। ६.७७.२० ।।
transliteration: sa tadā hriyamāṇo 'pi kumbhakarṇātmajena ha।ājaghānānilasuto vajrakalpena muṣṭinā ।। 6.77.20 ।।

translations.english: Hanuman, the son of wind god getting himself released from Nikumbha, springing up standing on the ground tormented Nikumbha.
